title: torenia anagallis
intro: Torenia anagallis, commonly known as Blue Anagallis, is a flowering plant species in the family Scrophulariaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help in reducing stress, anxiety, and promoting overall well-being.
